preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 3000 inclusive.
The maximum salary D is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of superior relationships is exactly n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= i for i, p_i in enumerate(superiors, start=2))
preconditions.description: Each employee i+1 has a direct superior p_i where 1 <= p_i <= i.

postconditions.description: The number of ways to assign salaries is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.
The return value is the number of valid ways to assign salaries to employees given the constraints.
